question: "The blue umbrella" is a novel written by famous Indian author ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ruskin Bond**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ruskin Bond:-**

 
 
• Ruskin Bond is considered as one of the greatest Indian authors of the English language.
 
• His writing career brought him fame, honours and a number of awards, including the Sahitya Academy Award (1992), Padma Shri (1991), Padma Bhushan (2014).
 
• Even though he was an average student in terms of academics, his writing talent was recognized as early as 1948, when he won the Anderson Prize.
